executiveSummary: The articles highlight significant trends in AI/ML, hardware, and industry shifts, with a focus on emerging technologies and companies. Apple is expanding its 6G modem development, while YouTube tests hiding the dislike button, and SpaceX is discussing a possible merger with Tesla. Meanwhile, Anthropic struggles to secure cloud compute, and Meta's Muse app tops 10 million downloads in 40 days.

takeaways.title: Apple 6G Modem Development
takeaways.description: Apple is hiring a 6G Cellular Modem Systems Engineer to define and build the next generation of cellular modems, which could impact future iPhone and Apple Watch sales, according to MacRumors.

takeaways.title: AI Safety and Regulations
takeaways.description: Anthropic pitches an AI safety bill that may block a model if it could cause harm to 50+ people, highlighting the need for regulatory oversight in the AI industry, as reported by TechCrunch.

takeaways.title: Cloud Compute and Anthropic
takeaways.description: Anthropic struggles to secure enough compute from cloud providers, which increasingly view it as a competitor, even as its infrastructure spending balloons ahead of a planned November IPO, according to TechCrunch.

worthWatching: SpaceX's AI business is beating expectations, with net income of $4.4 billion, according to TechCrunch.
YouTube tests hiding the dislike button, which could impact the platform's user experience and engagement metrics, according to The Verge.
engineeringPerspective: The development of 6G modems requires significant expertise in cellular networking and antenna design, as highlighted by MacRumors.
The use of cloud compute by AI companies like Anthropic presents challenges for scalability, security, and cost optimization, according to TechCrunch.
